s: Dine leqichat umekirat tallit ubo v' seipim: halloqeach tallit metzuyyetzet miyyisrael — hare zeh bechezqat kashrut, lepi shekkol yisrael beqiin beheksher tiqqun asiyyat hatztzitzit:

Halloqeach tallit metzuyyetzet mittaggar nokri, apillu eno taggar limkor tallitot ella hu taggar lishar sechorot, veomer shellaqach tallit zo miyyisrael im tzitziyyoteha — neeman, dachazaqa al hattaggar sheeno meshaqqer, sheim yimmatze badday bedabar echad lo yaaminuhu bidbarim acherim. Veen somekin al chazaqa zo ella keshemmoker tallit metzuyyetzet kehilkatah, deyesh od tzad lehaqel, mishshum deen derek nokri leda heak osin hachulyot vehaqqesharim umissetama leqachah im tzitziyyoteha miyyisrael. Abal en loqechin tzitzit sheenan teluyin battallit minnokri apillu hu taggar, shemma hu atzmo tevaan o shezaran:

Hashsholeach tzitzit lachabero beyad nokri — tzarik sheyyachtemennu chotam betok chotam, veal derek shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman qich, lepi sheyyesh lachosh shemma yachalip hannokri bechutin acherim shello nitvu leshem tzitzit. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehu beinyan sheyyehaneh hannokri bachalipin, abal im lo yihyeh lo hanaa kelal mechalipin — en chosheshin shemma yachalip hannokri kede lehakshil et yisrael:

Vekol zeh kesheshsholeach chutin sheenan shezurin, o apillu hen shezurin ella sheenan mupsaqin learba chutin arukkim raq adayin hen chut echad arok. Abal im hen shezurin umupsaqin learba chutin arukkim — en lachosh sheyyachalip otam hannokri, shebbevadday en lo chutin acherim kayyotze bahen, lepi sheen osin chutin al derek zeh ella leshem tzitzit:
Veken hammotze chute tzitzit bashshuq, im hem shezurin umupsaqin learba chutin arukkin — kesherim, shebbevadday leshem tzitzit naasu:

En mokerin tallit metzuyyetzet lenokri apillu hu taggar, shello yitlabbesh bah hannokri veyidmeh leyisrael haroeh oto shehu yisrael, shehare hu labush betzitzit, veyitlavveh immo badderek veyahargennu hannokri, shehannokri chashud al shepikat damim. Veken en memashkenin veen mapqidin tallit metzuyyetzet etzel nokri, ella im ken hu lepi shaa, beinyan sheen lachosh shemma yitlavveh immo yisrael badderek:
